checks.assertion: All paths are an explicit allowlist; no old confirmation file or confirmation score is read.
Declare supervised-window-budget diagnostic OR genuinely short target history; do not merge claims.
Record unique target origin sets for inner/support, meta, earlystop, tuning and their union, including calendar and H20 target endpoints.
Source support/labels/scaler/sampling rule/weight remain identical across target budgets; smaller target support is nested and covers matched dates.
For each allowed source or target label, its target date precedes the declared information cutoff; source row indices cannot replace a common calendar cutoff.
Fit/meta/validation separation is checked using target endpoints, with explicit overlap/purge policy; future labels never affect issued predictions.
Parameter sharing is separated from contemporaneous cross-market input fusion; any added inputs require separate causal timing and ablation.
Paired arms share price-risk objective, scale convention, output anchor/shrink, head/encoder initialization rules, validation support and sampler.
Extra inner steps, exact head solves, pretraining and meta access are counted; no claim that exact profile adds zero optimization cost.
Include local strong baseline, RW/stat/ridge anchors, pooled market-ID model and ordinary shared encoder/local heads, with duplicate controls removed.
Include one-step, sufficiently converged multistep head adaptation and exact ridge/profile on matched supports; specify convergence criterion in advance.
A matched mechanism-off version isolates the new operator; conventional source-pretrain/target-adapt is required when representation-transfer claims depend on it.
A same-X/opposite-response synthetic world preserves target-local mapping; a shared-response world permits variance benefit; duplicated sources are not treated as independent sample evidence.
checks.scope_note: Requirements only; no such test was executed in this audit.

checks.assertion: Predeclare target/market/horizon weighting and selection gates; overlapping horizons, related markets and seeds are not independent observations.
If converged multistep matches exact profile, attribute differences to approximation/optimization quality; do not claim novel mathematics.
Repeatedly exposed development years are not renamed as independent confirmation; old STOP conclusions remain unchanged.

synthetic_work_done: Symbolic derivation only; no numerical solver, synthetic optimizer or market training was run.
